title: media-publish job payload v1
description: app.job.payload of the server-internal job kind `media-publish` (MEDIA_PIPELINE.md 3). Written by the worker, read by the server's MediaPublishRunner, never by the API. Closed: the runner fails the child on any payload that does not validate (`invalid_payload`).

format_version.description: Payload version. The runner fails the child (`unsupported_format`) on any other value.

parent_job_id.description: The public parent job (kind media-import, media-parse or jpdb-deck-import).

media_id.description: The media (= its deck id). Equals the parent payload's media_id.

base_content_version.description: app.media.content_version the worker built on (0 = new media). The snapshots are published as base_content_version + 1; the runner rejects the child with `stale_base` if the media's current version differs.

create.description: Non-null iff base_content_version = 0 (first publish of a new media): values for media.created and the media deck's deck.created. Null for every later publish.

deck_items.description: The kotobaya-deck-items archive of the media deck (SNAPSHOT.md 4).

unmapped.description: Copied unchanged into JobResultMedia.unmapped. jpdb: exactly the jpdb.vocab entries with resolution unresolved, same order, same four members. Other sources: [].

jpdb.description: jpdb media only (media.source = jpdb), else null.

blob_hash.description: SHA-256 of the compressed bytes = object key; an app.blob row (kind snapshot, origin build) exists before the child is enqueued.

title.description: media.created title; the deck name is this title cut to its first 200 code points.

deck.description: The parent request's MediaDeckOptions with defaults filled in.

vocab.description: Every fetched deck row with a vid that the AUTOMATIC mapper could not map, one per vid (rows repeating a vid merged, counts summed), whatever the stored resolution; ordered by occurrence_count descending, then jpdb_vid ascending. The runner replaces the media's app.jpdb_vocab_media rows with exactly this list (MEDIA_PIPELINE.md 5.2).

resolution.description: The resolution the worker applied (read from app.jpdb_vocab when it mapped; unresolved if no row).

entry_seq.description: Set iff resolution = mapped: the seq the vid was mapped to.
